threats.title: Wallet file exfiltrated from a compromised device
threats.description: Malware or a local attacker steals the wallet file from the user's device and recovers the private keys it holds. The document states the file should be encrypted at rest and that encryption is a wallet option; whether it is enabled is not stated.
preconditions: the wallet file is unencrypted, or its encryption is defeated
threats.impact: Private key confidentiality is lost, and with it the funds the keys control.

threats.title: Trading-bot API keys stolen and abused
threats.description: An attacker obtains the trading bot's exchange API keys — through interception or leakage into logs — and issues unauthorized trades or reads account data.
preconditions: API keys are exposed in transit or at rest
the stolen keys carry more privilege than the bot's task requires
attack_path: obtain the bot's API keys from transit or a log store
trade or read account data against the exchange API with them
threats.impact: Unauthorized trading and account data exposure under the user's identity.

threats.title: Malicious ElectrumX server feeds false blockchain state
threats.description: A rogue or spoofed ElectrumX server returns incorrect balances or headers, leading the wallet to display or act on false blockchain state. ElectrumX servers are operated by third parties the user does not control.
preconditions: the wallet daemon accepts blockchain data from a server the user does not control without cross-validation
attack_path: operate or spoof an ElectrumX server the wallet connects to
threats.impact: The wallet displays or acts on false blockchain state.
